description:
Minions-side orchestration core: non-blocking `orchestrate`, groups, settled lifecycle, packets, spawn compatibility.

## Background

`pi-minions` is already the right runtime (in-process AgentSessions, AgentTree, steer/abort, transcripts). The blocker is semantic: spawn waits. This phase makes minions a background orchestration backend the parent can keep talking to.

This phase does not delete beadwork tmux. Beadwork cutover is a sibling phase. Different package, can proceed in parallel where files do not overlap.

## Why it exists

Without this, `/bw run` has nothing to call except tmux. All later messaging, packets, and epic loops sit on these APIs.

## Scope

Children under this epic. Do not implement this epic as one PR.

## Out of scope

Beadwork goal mode, tmux deletion, peer messaging, path intent (those are B/C). Do not add report/wait protocol tools.

## Success

Foreground spawn still blocks. Orchestrate returns handles immediately. Parent stays interactive. Settlement is not `agent_end`. Packets coalesce when idle. Spawn children are absent from orchestrated fleet snapshots.

comments.text: Package hotspot: SubsessionManager/spawn runner is one issue (child session lifecycle). types/nudges/role/tree/group can proceed in parallel after types. Do not add report/wait tools.

title: [EPIC] Minions orchestration core
